blocks.text: Light ki polarization ki basic (bunyadi) qismein yeh hain.

Jab electric field vector sirf ek plane mein aage peeche jhoole (oscillate kare) to light linearly polarized kehlati hai (Fig. 8.4 (a)). Misal: polarizing filter, jaise sunglasses, se guzarne wali light.

blocks.alt: x aur x' (pari), y aur y' (khari) aur z aur z' (gehrai mein) axes O par milti hain. Ek sine wave (lehar) x ke saath x-y surface (satah) mein chalti hai; axis se oopar ke aadhe hisse magenta khari lakeeron se aur neeche ke cyan lakeeron se bhare hain. Label: Space (3D).
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4 (a): Light ki linear polarization (kitab ki Figure 8.4 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khari lakeerein har point par E ki length (lambai) aur direction (simt) dikhati hain. Sab lakeerein ek hi (x-y) plane mein hain aur sirf oopar ya neeche hain: E kabhi z ki taraf nahi murta. Yahi linear (plane) polarization hai.

Jab electric field circle (daire) mein ghoome, ya to ghari ki suiyon ki direction mein (clockwise, right-handed) ya ulti direction mein (counterclockwise, left-handed), to light circularly polarized kehlati hai (Fig. 8.4 (b)). Misal: CD (Compact Disc) ya DVD (Digital Versatile Disc) se reflect hone wali light.

blocks.alt: Pari axis teer ke gird gehrai mein bana shaffaf cylinder, baen sire par khari axis. Axis se cylinder ki deewar par helix tak barabar length ki bohat si lakeerein, jo axis ke gird lagatar ghoomti hain. Isi radius ke surkh daire un ke siron ka rasta dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4 (b): Light ki circular polarization (kitab ki Figure 8.4 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Aik axis ke saath chalti circularly polarized light (roshni). Barabar length ke surkh electric field teer axis se bahar ki taraf lagatar badalte zaviyon par hain, aur un ke sire chalne ki direction ke gird lipte jamni helix par hain.
blocks.caption: Circular polarization (Figure 8.4b ke mutabiq asal 3D model; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Circular polarization mein electric field ki miqdar hamesha barabar rehti hai magar us ki direction har period mein aik chakkar ghoomti hai. Saamne se dekhein to E ka sira daire mein ghoomta hai; beam ke saath dekhein to helix banata hai.
labels: E keeps its size and turns
Tip of E traces a helix

fallback.text: Circular polarization: E ki miqdar barabar rehti hai aur woh lagatar ghoomta hai, is liye us ka sira beam ke saath helix banata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har lakeer ek instant (lamhe) ka E hai. Sab ki length barabar hai (magnitude yani miqdar nahi badalti) magar direction wave ke aage barhne ke saath ghoomti jati hai, is liye siron (tips) se ek spring jaisa helix banta hai. Samne se dekhein to sira red circle par ghoomta hai: yahi circular polarization hai. Upar wala 3D model ghuma kar dekhein.

Linear aur circular polarization ka mel, jis mein electric field vector ka sira ellipse (anda jaisi golai) banata hai, elliptical polarization kehlata hai. Is mein (Fig. 8.4(c)) electric field ke do components Eₓ aur E_y barabar nahi hote aur/ya un ke phase mein kisi bhi angle θ ka farq hota hai. Misal: stress plate ya waveplate se guzarne wali light.

blocks.alt: x aur y axes ke milne ki jagah par centre (markaz) wala tirchha ellipse. Centre se kaale teer E_x (x ke saath) aur E_y (y ke saath). Lambi axis par cyan lakeer a, chhoti axis par magenta lakeer b, aur y axis se lambi axis tak khamdaar teer theta.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4 (c): Light ki elliptical polarization (kitab ki Figure 8.4 (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: E ka sira daire ki bajaye ellipse par ghoomta hai kyun ke Eₓ aur E_y barabar nahi aur/ya un ke phase mein farq hai. a aur b ellipse ki aadhi lambi aur aadhi chhoti axes hain. Figure mein θ y-axis se ellipse ke tilt (jhukao) ka angle dikhata hai; text wala phase ka farq waqt ka farq hai, kaghaz par bana angle nahi, magar ellipse ka tilt isi phase farq aur Eₓ, E_y par depend karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Plane polarized aur circularly polarized light ke kuch istemal likhein (constructed response 8.1).
blocks.explanation: Plane polarized light: glare (chamak) kam karne wale polarized sunglasses aur camera filters, LCD screens, polarizer-analyzer se polarization pehchanna, optical activity se sugar solution (cheeni ke mehlool) ki concentration napna, aur materials ka stress analysis. Circular (aur elliptical) polarization tab banti hai jab light CD ya DVD jaisi surface se reflect ho ya stress plate ya waveplate se guzre; light ki polarization optical communication aur astronomy mein bhi istemal hoti hai.

items: Linear: E ek plane mein (polarizing filter, sunglasses). Circular: E clockwise (right-handed) ya counterclockwise (left-handed) ghoomta hai (CD/DVD se reflection). Elliptical: E ellipse banata hai; Eₓ aur E_y barabar nahi aur/ya phase mein θ ka farq (stress plate, waveplate).
